title: Guest Folio
key_sentences: Thank you for staying at The Lantern Court Hotel.
Please check the charges below before settling your account at the front desk.
Any query will be answered within two working days.
Your folio is kept for seven years to meet our accounting duties.
It is not shared with any third party except our auditors.

list_items.text: - Cash, card and bank transfer are accepted at the front desk.
- A receipt will be emailed to the address given at check-in.
- Charges for items not listed above can be added until 11:00 on the day of departure.
